findings.finding: Opening answer accurately covers civil rights but omits source's specific historical general rule: ecclesiastical authorities normally did not permit religious marriage before prescribed civil-law acts had been initiated. Do not confuse initiation with completed civil marriage, or apply as universal present-day law.

en.question: Why did the 1905 Catechism also require civil marriage formalities?
en.answer: The catechism says that civil formalities safeguard the civil rights of spouses and children. It adds that, as a general rule at the time, ecclesiastical authority did not permit religious marriage unless the acts required by civil law had at least been initiated. This is a historical disciplinary description, not a universal ruling about present-day marriage procedures.

fr.question: Pourquoi le Catéchisme de 1905 demandait-il aussi les formalités du mariage civil ?
fr.answer: Le catéchisme explique que les formalités civiles protègent les droits civils des époux et de leurs enfants. Il ajoute qu'en règle générale, à cette époque, l'autorité ecclésiastique ne permettait pas le mariage religieux avant que les démarches prescrites par la loi civile aient au moins été engagées. Il s'agit d'une description disciplinaire historique, non d'une règle universelle applicable aujourd'hui.
